messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Examples of CYP2B6 inhibitors include ticlopidine or clopidogrel.
Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of antidepressants.
Examples of antidepressants include venlafaxine, nortriptyline, imipramine, desipramine, paroxetine, fluoxetine, and sertraline.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of antipsychotics.
Examples of antipsychotics include haloperidol, risperidone, and thioridazine.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of beta-blockers.
An example of a beta-blocker is metoprolol.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of Type 1C antiarrhythmics.
Examples of Type 1C antiarrhythmics include propafenone and flecainide.
These medicines are metabolized by CYP2D6.
A dose reduction of antidepressants may be considered when used with bupropion.
Dopaminergic drugs (levodopa and amantadine): CNS toxicity can occur when used concomitantly with Bupropion.
Not all possible interactions are listed in this medication guide.
Triplet: ["this medication guide", "has limitation", "not all possible interactions are listed"]

The relation 'has limitation' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject document or guide has a limitation described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
C. 'can be targeted by': The object entity is at risk of being misused or exploited by the subject entity.
D. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
